stories.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
stories.summary: CISA has added two new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation.
stories.why_it_matters: Defenders should treat this as an immediate exposure-management priority, confirm whether affected systems are internet-facing, review available indicators, and apply verified vendor mitigations or updates.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated RCE
stories.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have urged users to discontinue using a legacy ASP.NET anti-CSRF library named Idunno.AntiCsrf ("Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll") following the discovery of a critical vulnerability that has been exploited in the wild.
stories.why_it_matters: Defenders should treat this as an immediate exposure-management priority, confirm whether affected systems are internet-facing, review available indicators, and apply verified vendor mitigations or updates.

stories.title: CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks

stories.title: Critical binary-parser Flaw Enables JavaScript Injection via Malicious Parser Definitions
stories.summary: A critical security flaw has been disclosed in the popular binary-parser library that could allow an attacker who controls parser definitions to execute arbitrary code.
stories.why_it_matters: Organizations should inventory potentially affected products, review the original advisory, and monitor for credible exploitation evidence.

stories.title: South Korea’s power giant KEPCO confirms data breach impacting 1.5 million
